settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
SemiProbe manufactures a family of probe arms used across a variety of applications — DC (coaxial, triaxial, Kelvin), HF, OPTO, high voltage, high current and more. Each arm mounts to the precision dovetail faceplate shared across the manipulator range, so arms can be swapped without replacing the manipulator body.

Our probe arms are designed to fit SemiProbe manufactured probe systems, manipulators and our adjustable probe arm faceplate. We also manufacture customised probe arms — length, bend and cable length. For customised solutions please contact us.

settings.heading: Choosing a Configuration
settings.bar_text: Unsure which arm fits your manipulator, or need a custom length or bend?

settings.title: START WITH THE MEASUREMENT
settings.description: Coaxial arms cover general DC and low-frequency probing. Triaxial arms add a driven guard for low-current and guarded measurement. High-frequency arms are built for RF, microwave and millimetre-wave work.

settings.title: MATCH THE LENGTH TO THE BODY
settings.description: Short arms are specific to the compact MA-8005. Long arms suit the MA-9000 and MA-9100. The high-frequency West/East and North/South arms are oriented to the station layout rather than sized short or long.

settings.title: CHECK THE MANIPULATOR FIRST
settings.description: Every arm mounts on the shared dovetail faceplate, but not every arm fits every body. Use the compatibility table above, and note that HF arms require a magnetic base on the MA-9000 and MA-9100.

settings.question: Can I swap a probe arm without replacing the manipulator?
settings.answer: Yes. Every arm mounts to the dovetail faceplate, so it can be swapped on the bench without replacing the manipulator body. Check the compatibility table above first — each model supports a different set of arm types.

settings.question: What is the difference between a coaxial and a triaxial arm?
settings.answer: A coaxial arm carries the signal inside a single screen and suits general DC and low-frequency probing. A triaxial arm adds a driven guard around the signal conductor, which substantially reduces leakage and makes it the right choice for low-current and guarded measurement.

settings.question: Do you make custom probe arms?
settings.answer: Yes. We manufacture customised arms by length, bend and cable length, and also supply OPTO, high voltage and high current variants. Contact us with your application and we will quote it.

settings.question: Will these arms fit a non-SemiProbe probe station?
settings.answer: The arms are designed around the SemiProbe adjustable probe arm faceplate. If you are mounting on another manufacturer's manipulator, send us the faceplate details and we will confirm fit before you order.

settings.heading: Need a Custom Probe Arm?
settings.body: SemiProbe manufactures probe arms to order — custom lengths, bends and cable lengths, plus OPTO, high voltage and high current variants for proprietary test environments.
